segments.text: The page simply says you are not logged in.
I look at the response headers with a head request, and the server sets a cookie named loggedin with the value zero.
That cookie is stored on our side, and the server trusts whatever value we send back, so I set the cookie to one myself and request the page again.
The server sees loggedin equals one and prints the password for natas six, and the level is solved.
